patterns.note: Content is centrally aligned within a full-bleed, dark-toned background image, creating a focused and immersive age-gate experience.
A sophisticated serif font is used for the main welcome message, contrasted with a clean, all-caps sans-serif for form labels and smaller text, establishing an elegant and authoritative tone.
A high-contrast palette of near-black background and light text is used, with subtle golden-beige accents for decorative elements, enhancing readability and luxury.
The page is static; no scroll-triggered motion or animations are observed in the provided images.

technique_notes: Full-bleed background image with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text legibility, centered content block for the age gate form. Decorative leaf motifs are positioned in the corners, slightly overlapping the main content area.
The page is static; no scroll-triggered motion or animations are present. All elements are loaded and displayed immediately.
Typography combines a refined, elegant serif for primary headings with a clean, modern sans-serif for all supporting text and form labels, often set in uppercase for a structured and premium feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, medium-sized serif heading (~2x body) paired with smaller, often uppercase sans-serif labels and body text, creating a refined hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on the CTA button, otherwise sharp).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between form elements and text blocks, creating a sense of calm and importance).

standout: The use of a full-bleed, atmospheric, dark-toned background image with elegant, minimal typography creates a sophisticated and exclusive feel for an age gate, rather than a purely functional barrier. The subtle illustrative elements (leaves, sunburst) add a touch of brand identity without being distracting.
